description: This file contains low-level ARM assembly code implementing a quantized GEMM (matrix multiplication) kernel optimized for the AARCH32 architecture with NEON instructions. It defines the function `pytorch_q8gemm_dq_ukernel_4x8__aarch32_neon` used for efficient quantized tensor operations in PyTorch, specifically for 8-bit integer matrix multiplication with quantization parameters.

methods.name: pytorch_q8gemm_dq_ukernel_4x8__aarch32_neon
methods.description: Assembly implementation of a quantized 8-bit GEMM kernel optimized for ARM NEON, performing matrix multiplication with per-channel requantization, zero point subtraction, and final result storage.
